Anime film still, hand-painted cel style, cinematic lighting, rich color, clean linework, vertical 9:16 frame, night, steady rain, dense neon city in pink and teal. Low wide shot across a flat wet rooftop. a young courier girl in a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down, short black bob haircut, a dark green messenger bag across her body sprints toward the camera, mid-stride, splashing through puddles, looking back over her shoulder in fear. Behind her the rooftop stretches back: a tall wooden water tower with a metal ladder on the left, a small stairwell hut with a red metal door in the center, a short pole on the right edge. Behind the roof rises the dark wall of a taller building. No other people.

Anime film still, hand-painted cel style, cinematic lighting, rich color, clean linework, vertical 9:16 frame, night, steady rain, dense neon city in pink and teal. High three-quarter shot from behind. a young courier girl in a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down, short black bob haircut, a dark green messenger bag across her body stands alone in the middle of a flat wet rooftop, seen from behind, facing a tall neon skyscraper across the street at the top of the frame. On the left, a tall wooden water tower with a metal ladder up its side. In the center, a small stairwell hut with a red metal door, and from the top of the hut an enclosed glass skybridge stretches across the street to the skyscraper. On the right edge, a short pole with a taut steel zipline cable that slopes down across the street to a lit catwalk on the skyscraper. Far away in the upper left, small, on the parapet of a taller neighboring building, three ninjas dressed all in black with red scarves crouch, watching her. Lots of empty wet roof between her and everything.

Anime film still, hand-painted cel style, cinematic lighting, rich color, clean linework, vertical 9:16 frame, night, steady rain, dense neon city in pink and teal. Shot from behind and slightly above. a young courier girl in a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down, short black bob haircut, a dark green messenger bag across her body crouches on a narrow steel catwalk bolted to the side of a skyscraper, high above the street. On the left, a giant glowing billboard of abstract pink and blue light shapes with no words. Above the billboard, on the skyscraper roof, a tall red and white radio antenna mast. Below on the right, an elevated train with lit windows runs on its track. In the lower right corner, across the street and lower down, the flat wet rooftop she escaped from, with a wooden water tower and a small hut with a red door; on that rooftop stand three tiny ninjas in black, far away. A steel zipline cable slopes from that rooftop up to the catwalk. She is alone on the catwalk.
